name: field-type-link-step
title: Field Type Link Step
description: The "Links to" step of FieldTypePicker — grouped kinds of record, each with one line on what a link to it does, and a table choice for a kind that lives in a table (Rows).

meta.whenToUse: A link field's second step in FieldTypePicker's renderStep: which kind of record it points at, and for rows which table.
meta.whenNotToUse: Picking a record itself (RecordPicker), or a field type (FieldTypePicker).
